name: appearance
title: Appearance
description: createAppearance and <Appearance>: keep the .dark class, data-theme, data-palette, data-density and data-radius on <html> in sync with a color scheme (system follows prefers-color-scheme live, or light or dark), a theme, a palette, a density (default or compact) and a corner radius (none, sm, md, lg or full), optionally saved between visits. Works in a static file:// page.
